note.id: Kampung di barat Malioboro dengan jalan bernama tokoh wayang. Sebagian besar jaringannya bertanda living street, bukan jalan perumahan biasa.
note.en: A kampung west of Malioboro with streets named after wayang figures. Most of its network is tagged living street rather than ordinary residential road.
